{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.26

|gr1= GUI Control

|descr= Returns the class name of a [[Control]] as it is defined in config. If you need config class of a game created [[Display]], it is stored on display itself:
<sqf>_className = findDisplay 12 getVariable ["BIS_fnc_initDisplay_configClass", ""]; // "RscDiary"</sqf>

|s1= [[ctrlClassName]] control

|p1= control : [[Control]]

|r1= [[String]] - class name

|x1= List class names of all controls present on display 46:
<sqf>
_return = [];
{
	_return pushBack format ["IDC: %1, className: %2", ctrlIDC _x, ctrlClassName _x];
} forEach (allControls findDisplay 46);

copyToClipboard (_return joinString endl);
</sqf>

|seealso= [[ctrlIDC]] [[ctrlIDD]] [[ctrlType]] [[ctrlCreate]] [[ctrlDelete]] [[ctrlModel]] [[ctrlSetModel]] [[ctrlPosition]] [[ctrlSetPosition]] [[ctrlModelScale]] [[ctrlSetModelScale]] [[ctrlModelDirAndUp]] [[ctrlSetModelDirAndUp]]
}}
